summary: Re-test after AxiosError 404 bug fix. Backend 10/10 pytest pass. Frontend end-to-end verified: login -> register TV -> open /display/{tvId} renders tv-display with NO 404/502 and NO console/page errors; TV goes ONLINE in admin table (WS connect + 8s poll refresh confirmed); unregistered TV shows friendly 'This TV is not registered' message and tv-display is NOT rendered; realtime WebSocket 'reload' on Settings save triggers display refetch (observed /api/display GETs increase). The service worker cache fix (only cache 200 media, hm-signage-v2) and Display.js transient error handling (only 404 fatal, 5xx retries with cache) are working as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend GET /api/display serves settings including the mongo internal 'key':'global' field (harmless but leaks internal key).
server.py uses on_event startup/shutdown (deprecated in FastAPI). Consider lifespan handlers.
ADMIN_PASSWORD fallback 'admin123' exists in code but env supplies Halal@2026; ensure this fallback stays out of production.
seed_data_creation: Test-created TVs prefixed TEST_ were cleaned up via API DELETE after test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug is fixed. Register-TV -> open-display -> ONLINE flow works end-to-end with zero console errors. Unregistered TV -> friendly message. Realtime reload via WS works. Service worker v2 no longer caches transient error responses. Only 404 on unregistered TV is expected (surfaces friendly message). Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env.
rca of the issue: Original AxiosError 404 root causes: (1) service worker v1 was caching transient 404/502 responses and serving them thereafter, (2) Display.js treated any error as fatal. Fixes verified: sw.js only caches ok media (cache bumped to hm-signage-v2), Display.js now treats only HTTP 404 as fatal and retries transient 5xx/network every 5s using cached content. Reproduction of the failure is no longer possible in current build.
